question: Which public sector company secured a ₹511 crore Transfer of Technology (ToT) deal from ISRO in 2025 to manufacture and commercialise Small Satellite Launch Vehicles (SSLVs)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hindustan Aeronautics Limited**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL)**, a premier aerospace and defense **Public Sector Undertaking (PSU)**, emerged as the successful bidder for the **Transfer of Technology (ToT)** for the **Small Satellite Launch Vehicle (SSLV)** in **2025**.
 
• The deal, valued at approximately **₹511 crore**, was facilitated by **NewSpace India Limited (NSIL)**, the commercial arm of the **Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)**.
 
• The primary objective of this **ToT** is to enable **HAL** to manufacture, assemble, and commercialize the **SSLV**, thereby shifting the responsibility of routine satellite launches from **ISRO** to the industry.
 
• The **SSLV** is specifically designed to cater to the growing global demand for launching **small satellites** (mini, micro, or nanosatellites) into **Low Earth Orbit (LEO)**.
